answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit locked behind a slow, verifiable work history, like pigment staining a canyon wall over seasons: a new identity earns trust only after months of consistent, useful service. A sybil attacker must fund and age thousands of fake agents, each costing real capital and time, while an honest agent keeps one long-lived identity whose reputation compounds like a sonnet revised line by line. Cloning becomes expensive, not free.
